# Hero Image Spec — Manaaki (Hospitality)

**Purpose:** Static visual for V3 (proof-led) cold email + LinkedIn share card. Café owner / food-safety manager opens the email, sees a real-looking FCP verification pack, recognises the shape of a document they'd hand to an MPI verifier.

**Generated by:** Kate (Vessel Studio) OR delegated to a designer
**Saved to:** `/public/assets/hero/manaaki-evidence.png` in the repo, then deployed
**Final URL:** `https://www.assembl.co.nz/assets/hero/manaaki-evidence.png`

---

## Composition

- **Aspect ratio:** 16:9 (1600 × 900 px, retina 3200 × 1800 px)
- **Subject:** Flat-design rendering of an open FCP verification pack on warm cream paper. Two pages — left page cover, right page citations / gap-disclosure section.
- **Background:** Warm paper `#FAF7F2`. No photographic texture.
- **Pack rendering:** Flat illustration. Brand-canon typography + palette only.
- **Vessel cameo:** Top-right corner — Evidence Vessel motif at 15% of canvas height.

---

## Page content (visible in the mock-pack)

**Left page (cover):**
- Top eyebrow: `assembl · evidence pack` (IBM Plex Mono uppercase, taupe)
- H1: `Food Control Plan Verification Pack — Q1 2026` (Cormorant Garamond, weight 400, pounamu)
- Sub-line: `Roastery & Co · Mount Eden · Food Act 2014`
- Date: `21 March 2026`
- Decision pill: `✅ APPROVED for MPI verifier presentation` (pounamu fill, cream text)

**Right page (gap-disclosure section — the punchline):**
- H2: `Disclosed gaps (2)` (Cormorant Garamond, weight 300)
- Gap entry 1: `Bain-marie thermometer calibration missed · 14 Feb 2026`
  - Corrective action drafted: "Calibration logged on 19 Feb, all subsequent shifts compliant."
  - Status pill: `✓ disclosed + closed`
- Gap entry 2: `Supplier complaint — poultry delivery 6°C · 22 Mar 2026`
  - Status pill: `⚠ open — escalated to supplier`
- Footer: citation rows partially visible (`Food Act 2014 s 39`, `Food Regs 2015 reg 30`)

The two-gap disclosure is the visual STORY. assembl finds the things you'd miss + drafts the disclosure language. Verifier sees the gaps disclosed proactively, not hidden.

---

## Text overlay (embedded in image)

- **Top-left:** small Cormorant italic caption: `Manaaki · Q1 FCP verification pack · approved by Aroha Williams, Owner-Operator · 21 March 2026`
- **Bottom-centre:** H1 statement: `Mahi that earns its proof.` (Cormorant Garamond, weight 300)
- **No CTA in the image itself.**

## Vessel Studio prompt

```
A flat-design editorial composition. 16:9 aspect ratio. Warm cream
paper background (#FAF7F2). Subject: an open two-page PDF document at
slight perspective — left page is a verification-pack cover for a New
Zealand café, right page shows two "disclosed gap" entries with
plain-English corrective-action language. Cream ceramic Evidence Vessel
motif top-right corner. Cormorant Garamond headings, IBM Plex Mono
small labels, Inter body. No photography, no AI shimmer. Style: Aesop
catalogue meets Cereal magazine quietness, with the warmth of a small
café. Subtle drop-shadows under document pages. The phrase "Mahi that
earns its proof." sits in Cormorant weight 300 at the bottom centre.
```

---

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Aspect 16:9 (1600×900 minimum, retina preferred)
- [ ] Cream `#FAF7F2` background dominant ≥80%
- [ ] Pounamu `#2B6B57` only on approval pill + section rules
- [ ] Two-gap disclosure section visually clear at LinkedIn thumbnail size
- [ ] No AI shimmer / no neon / no glow effects
- [ ] No bitmap photography of food or kitchens (we sell compliance proof, not lifestyle imagery)
- [ ] Lowercase `assembl` if wordmark visible

---

**Time to generate (Vessel Studio + 1-2 retakes): ~5 minutes of Kate's time.**
